title: 🔥 God renames futures.
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly…
Hidden among the stones of the desert, I watch Abram kneel in the fading light. The wind moves across the sand as the moment unfolds in sacred stillness.
Then comes the words that change everything:
“No longer will you be called Abram… your name will be Abraham.”

Not just a new name.
A new future.

Abram meant exalted father.
But Abraham means father of many nations.
The land around him still looks empty… the promise not yet visible. Yet God speaks identity before the outcome exists.
Watching from the shadows as a witness, I realize something that echoes through all of Scripture…
God often names who we are before the world can see it.
…And maybe that is where faith begins.
I am only a witness to this moment in Scripture, yet it makes me wonder…
What future might God already be speaking over a life today?
